export.heading: Export an account
export.subtitle: Make a package of one account to bring it to another Maran server.

form.hint: Exporting takes a backup of the account first, which can take as long as a backup does. The account keeps running.

detail.title: Account export
detail.heading: Export of {name}
detail.subtitle: Carry the key fingerprint to the other server, then take the package there.
detail.notFoundDescription: It has expired or never existed. Export the account again to make a new package.

package.title: The package
package.plaintext: The package is not encrypted. It holds the account's files and database contents until it expires, so keep it where only you can read it and delete it once the import is done.

fingerprint.title: Key fingerprint
fingerprint.intro: The receiving server accepts the package only if it was signed by the key with this fingerprint. Type it there yourself; do not send it together with the package.

grants.title: Pull grants
grants.intro: A grant lets one other panel pull this package once, without you handing over the file. Its token is shown once.
grants.allowedFromHint: Leave empty to allow any address.
grants.allowedFromInvalid: Enter addresses or ranges such as 203.0.113.10 or 203.0.113.0/24, separated by commas.
grants.lifetimeHint: Up to {max}. Leave empty for the panel's default.
grants.lifetimeInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to {max}.
grants.revokeQuestion: A panel holding its token can no longer pull the package.
grants.heading: Pull grants
grants.subtitle: The single-use grants with which another panel pulls an exported package. A grant's token was shown once and is not kept.
grants.emptyDescription: Open an export and issue a grant so that another panel can pull its package.
grants.noResultsDescription: Change the search or the filter, or clear them to see every grant.

token.title: Pull grant issued
token.warning: Copy the token now. It is shown only once; the panel keeps only a digest of it and cannot show it again.

list.heading: Account exports
list.subtitle: The packages you made to bring accounts to another Maran server. A package is served until it expires.
list.emptyDescription: Export an account to make a package another Maran server can import.
list.noResultsDescription: Change the search, or clear it to see every export.

import.heading: Import an account
import.subtitle: Bring in an account from a package another Maran server exported.

form.fileHint: The .maranpkg file the export on the other server produced. It is verified before anything is created.
form.fingerprint: Key fingerprint of the sending server
form.fingerprintHint: Read it on the sending server's export screen and type it here. The package is accepted only if that key signed it.
form.hint: A large package takes a while to upload. Keep this page open until it is verified.

detail.title: Account import
detail.heading: Import of {name}
detail.subtitle: From {host}
detail.notFoundDescription: It never existed or its package was removed. Upload the package again.

plan.title: Dry run
plan.intro: Choose the plan the account is created against, then judge the package against this server. Nothing is created.

report.title: Dry-run report
report.canStart: No conflicts. The import can start.
report.blocked: The import cannot start while a conflict remains. Resolve them, then run the dry run again.
report.none: Nothing in the package conflicts with this server.

confirm.title: Start the import
confirm.intro: Type the account's name and the sending server's key fingerprint again, so you create the account you checked from the server you checked.
confirm.fingerprintHint: Type the fingerprint you entered when you uploaded the package.
confirm.discardQuestion: The uploaded package is deleted. Nothing was created on this server.

progress.title: Import in progress
progress.intro: The account is being created. This page updates by itself.
progress.tasks: Follow it in the background tasks

outcome.afterTitle: What to know after the import
outcome.secretsIntro: The import generated credentials for the databases and logins it created. They can be shown once.
outcome.rolledBack: The import failed and was rolled back. Nothing was left on this server. Fix the cause and upload the package again.
outcome.rolledBackIncomplete: The import failed and could not be rolled back completely. The account {name} remains on this server; review it and delete it if you do not want it.
outcome.discarded: This package was discarded. Nothing was created.

secrets.title: Generated credentials
secrets.warning: Copy these now. They are shown only once and the panel cannot show them again.

list.heading: Account imports
list.subtitle: The packages you accepted from other Maran servers, and how each import went.
list.emptyDescription: Upload a package, or pull one from another panel, to start the first import.
list.taskLabel: Open the background task of the import of {name}
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by account or server name…
list.noResultsDescription: Change the search or the filter, or clear them to see every import.
